capabilities: Capture memos and tasks with a persistent quick composer
Store one memo per Markdown file with YAML frontmatter
Search, filter by tags, pin, edit, archive, and delete memos
Attach images, video, audio, and other files in the vault
Browse memos in a date-grouped two-column card timeline
disambiguation: Not a client for the usememos Memos server; it needs no database or remote service and keeps memos as ordinary vault files.
extras: Part of the README is written in Chinese. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and it states its plugin ID does not conflict with the Thino plugin (formerly obsidian-memos). Attachments are stored in Memos/_attachments/ rather than .obsidian/plugins/ so they sync and index properly.
intentEvidence: 一个以 Obsidian Vault 为唯一数据源的快速记录插件
motivation: The author wanted a fast-capture experience modeled on usememos/memos while keeping the Obsidian vault as the only data source, so nothing depends on the Memos backend.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Memos-style quick capture view where each short note or task is its own portable Markdown file without a database or remote service.

relations.evidence: 交互信息层级参考了 usememos/memos 的快速记录体验

summary: Quick-capture plugin that stores each memo as a plain Markdown file and shows them in a searchable, taggable card timeline inside Obsidian.
